manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top of a throw, velocity stops for an instant while gravity continues accelerating the ball downward.
manifest.description: Two vertical side-by-side lanes compare a tossed ball with a ball dropped from rest at the apex height. Blue velocity and orange acceleration arrows show continuous downward gravity throughout.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
